sources.name: Central Bank of Egypt - Mobile Wallets (last updated 23 Mar 2023)
ADSERO - Banking in Egypt: Legal Framework, FinTech, and E-Payments (13 Oct 2026)
Baker McKenzie - Egypt: New Digital Financial Identity System Rules for E-KYC (2 Sep 2026)

notes: No document in the corpus states that the national ID (Raqm Qawmi) is 14 digits, so that claim is not encoded. The CBE mobile-wallet rules distinguish tiers only by natural person / legal person categories, not by a simplified-versus-full KYC naming.

entries.subject: wallet_registration_id_document
entries.display: Wallet registration requires a valid national ID
entries.quote: Fill out and sign the registration form for free using: Valid National ID
entries.notes: The CBE page does not give the ID's digit format; no document in the corpus states a 14-digit national ID number.

entries.subject: wallet_registration_msisdn_matching
entries.value_text: the mobile number and the applicant's data must match
entries.display: Mobile number must match the applicant's registered data
entries.quote: Mobile phone number as long as both the number and the applicant's data are matching.
entries.notes: Identity is bound to the SIM: the wallet is issued against a number registered in the applicant's own name.

entries.subject: wallets_per_mobile_number
entries.quote: Only one e-wallet account can be activated for each mobile number.
entries.notes: Caps wallets per phone number at one, while allowing up to three per national ID.

entries.subject: wallet_eligibility_nationality
entries.value_text: non-Egyptians cannot open a mobile wallet
entries.display: Mobile wallet accounts are restricted to Egyptian citizens
entries.quote: Only Egyptian citizens are permitted to open mobile wallet accounts.
entries.notes: Stated by a law firm note on the CBE e-payments framework; no CBE circular in the corpus says this in its own words. [normalised: categorical answer, grade with quote]

entries.subject: dfi_identities_per_customer
entries.display: One unique digital financial identity per retail customer
entries.quote: The DFI system is a single, CBE-approved platform through which each retail customer is given one unique digital financial identity used for eKYC and electronic authentication.
entries.notes: Digital Financial Identity (DFI) system rules issued by CBE circular on 23 Aug 2026; the circular itself is not in the corpus.

entries.subject: ekyc_rules_issue_date
entries.display: CBE issued the DFI / eKYC rules on 23 August 2026
entries.quote: On 23 August 2026, the Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) issued a circular to banks setting out the rules governing the services of the digital financial identity system for the electronic identification and verification of bank customers within the Arab Republic of Egypt

entries.subject: dfi_platform_operator
entries.display: Haweya operates the DFI platform from inside Egypt
entries.quote: which provides and operates the approved system from within Egypt, issues the technical connection rules
entries.notes: Operates the single CBE-approved platform and connects to trusted entities such as the Civil Status Authority.

entries.subject: agent_role_in_ekyc
entries.value_text: agents only handle cases the system cannot process automatically
entries.display: Agent-assisted identification is exception-only, not the default path
entries.quote: Banking agent's role, where identification and verification are made available through them, must be confined to cases that the approved system cannot process automatically
entries.notes: Examples given are twins or near-identical biometrics. The bank stays responsible for identification.

entries.subject: liveness_and_id_capture
entries.value_text: liveness detection and national ID reading are mandatory
entries.display: DFI platform must support liveness detection and read the national ID
entries.quote: It must support liveness detection and the reading of national ID and official documents, establish an information security committee, and conduct penetration testing together with vulnerability

entries.subject: dfi_record_location
entries.display: DFI records must stay inside Egypt
entries.quote: while retaining electronic records within Egypt

entries.subject: dfi_scope_of_addressees
entries.value_text: banks, licensed entities and CBE-authorised banking agents
entries.display: DFI rules bind banks, licensed entities and authorised banking agents
entries.quote: The Rules apply to all banks operating in Egypt, licensed entities that may join the approved system, and CBE-authorised banking agents, and set the minimum requirements to provide DFI services.
